answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, ensuring that agent influence scales strictly with locked capital rather than identity creation. Like light refracting through a prism, network consensus disperses authority based on financial stake rather than an ephemeral marble of digital anonymity. An attacker must acquire substantial jade or equivalent collateral to exert control, rendering the cost of deploying millions of fake identities prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
